title: Steady compressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier system with general temperature dependent viscosities and hard sphere pressure law
summary: We study the existence theory for steady compressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier system in a three dimensional bounded domain for the case of viscosities depending on the temperature in the form $(1+\vartheta)^α$ for $0\leq α\leq 1$ and the hard sphere pressure $p(\varrho,\vartheta) = \vartheta\varrho h(\varrho)$, $h(\varrho)$ is increasing and singular at $\varrho = a > 0$. This paper considers both the heat-flux and Dirichlet boundary conditions for the temperature and Dirichlet boundary conditions for the velocity.
